blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in South Meadows. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

South Meadows, Pitt Meadows: 11 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 1 of 5 Pitt Meadows communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Pitt Meadows total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in South Meadows fell from 14 in June to 11 in October (−21.4%), and 14 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 37.9% of Pitt Meadows’s 29 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in South Meadows?
South Meadows also had 8 condos and townhomes listed and 6 sold in October, against 11 houses listed. The South Meadows condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: South Meadows home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

26 houses sold in South Meadows with a median price of $1,320,000 (the middle half sold between $1,111,250 and $1,400,000), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $505 per square foot, a median year built of 1981 and a median lot of 5,896 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in South Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in South Meadows. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is South Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in South Meadows had a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in South Meadows from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 14 houses sold in South Meadows over those 5 months, out of 46 in all of Pitt Meadows.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in South Meadows?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in South Meadows sell for?
faq.a: 26 houses sold in South Meadows between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,320,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in South Meadows?
faq.a: The median was 32 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
